turns.question: What was our real revenue in the first ten days of October 2026?
turns.answer: Revenue was EUR 2,137.34 for 1 to 10 October 2026 (gross: the sum of non-cancelled order amounts, not net of returns). Freshness: Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
